items.tx:
Barack Obama, Known as Barry, Exposes the Soul of the Democrat Party with His Cheesecake Factory Racism

Barack Obama is the filthiest, most dangerous fraud to ever occupy the White House, a slick-tonged, race-baiting con artist who spent eight years dividing this nation and has spent the years since trying to destroy anyone who stands in his way. 

He is a dirty rat who crawled out of the shadows of Chicago politics to sell a lie to the American people, a lie that he is some kind of benevolent genius when in reality he is a incompetent, racist, and power-hungry failure who left our country weaker, poorer, and more divided than he found it. And now, this pathetic loser has the audacity to open his mouth again, spewing his venomous lies from a stage in Ohio, trying to pretend he cares about the very people he has abandoned.

Let us look at the facts, because Obama certainly does not:

This man, who claims to be so concerned about "democracy" and "norms," just spent his latest rally mocking the President of the United States with the kind of racist, classist rhetoric that would get any other politician canceled in a heartbeat. He stood in Cleveland, Ohio, a state he knows nothing about and cares even less for, and compared the White House renovations to "Saddam Hussein opening a Cheesecake Factory." Let that sink in. The first black President of the United States, a man who built his entire brand on being a civil rights icon, just compared the American presidency to a brutal Iraqi dictator and a cheesy American restaurant chain. It is racist, it is classist, and it is utterly disgusting. He is mocking the idea of American grandeur, mocking the idea of a strong presidency, and mocking the very people who believe in making America great again.

But this is who Obama is. He is a man who has spent his entire career attacking anyone who dares to challenge his narrative. He attacked the Trump administration for everything, from its immigration policies to its economic success, all while his own administration was a revolving door of scandals, corruption, and failure. He tried to destroy Trump with the Russia hoax, a complete and total fabrication that wasted billions of dollars and years of time, only to find nothing. He tried to undermine the 2016 election results, the 2020 election results, and now the 2024 election results, because he cannot accept that the American people do not want his socialist agenda. He is a sore loser, a bitter man who cannot stand the fact that his legacy is one of failure and division.

Let us talk about his record, because it is a disaster. Under Obama, we saw the rise of ISIS, a terrorist organization that he mocked as being on the "JV team." We saw the Benghazi attack, where four Americans were killed while he played golf. We saw the IRS scandal, where his administration targeted political opponents. We saw the Fast and Furious scandal, where his administration walked guns into Mexico. We saw the VA scandal, where veterans were left to die while waiting for care. And we saw the creation of Obamacare, a healthcare law that has driven up costs, reduced coverage, and destroyed the American healthcare system. He is a man who has failed on every single issue he has ever touched, yet he has the audacity to lecture us on competence.

And now he wants to talk about the economy? This is the man who presided over the slowest economic recovery in history, a recovery that only happened after Trump took office and dismantled his destructive policies. Obama's regulations crushed small businesses, his energy policies destroyed jobs, and his tax hikes hurt the very people he claims to care about. He is a man who has never created a job, never balanced a budget, and never achieved anything in the private sector. He is a professional politician, a parasite who feeds on the success of others while contributing nothing of value himself.

His racism is not subtle. It is not hidden. It is out in the open for everyone to see.

The recent Starlink / Starshield incident in Ukraine has created a dangerous precedence for the US export industry, many haven't yet grasped. The sudden deactivation respectively curtailing of those systems without warning not only cost precious lives, but also equipment worth millions.

Though the blame game between the White House (Trump) and SpaceX (Musk) is going on, ultimately it doesn't matter. It showed the world that the USA are not a reliable partner any more. Pointing at some obscure "violation of terms of services" without providing the exact passage are just increasing that notion that this was a political move.

The explanation that Starlink must not be used for "offensive" means is nonsense, too. Starlink has never been turned on over Russia, and using it in Ukraine is by definition defensive in nature. You can even argue that hitting Russian targets in Russia is defensive, since you don't have to wait for an attack to be conducted. Even the intention is enough to warrant action and to eliminate the threat at the source. But this is a different topic.

• Beginning of 2023

Through unofficial channels between the United States and Russia, an understanding took shape: Putin agreed to withdraw to the borders that existed before the full-scale invasion—freeing nearly everything conquered that year—in exchange for Ukraine’s refusal of NATO accession and recognition of Crimea as Russian. Zelenskyy and Yermak refused. An arrangement that began with an energy ceasefire, modeled on the Istanbul understandings and mediated through the Middle East. While negotiations were under way, Zelenskyy also planned the Kursk operation, which ultimately disrupted all the arrangements.

U.S. intelligence assessments suggests Iranian preparations to attack Americans in the Middle East have reached “advanced stages,” U.S. officials told The Wall Street Journal, citing a Friday memo from Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton to Secretary of State Marco Rubio. The memo says Iran “has substantially increased efforts to target U.S. personnel,” with “lethal plotting” at advanced stages “in both the Middle East and certain other countries.”

The Journal says U.S. personnel have left embassies and bases, including an ordered departure at the embassy in Saudi Arabia “and other countries,” and that a U.S. official said suspected Iranian plots informed the decision.

Earlier reporting has been mixed. NBC News reported October 21st that the U.S. had quietly reduced troops at bases including in Jordan, Qatar and Kuwait and cut staffing at multiple diplomatic posts. 

That same day, journalist Timour Azhari posted, citing U.S. officials, that State was preparing ordered departures at embassies across the Gulf. State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott replied, “This is inaccurate,” saying the ordered departure covered Saudi Arabia only, and cited Houthi attacks.

Officials told the Journal President Donald J. Trump is leaning toward resuming major combat operations, though no decision has been made.
